none: PAS DOR-A1CCB1: Hoard of late Roman coins in a pottery vessel
contea di ritrovamento: Dorset (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ D N VALENTINIANVS P F AVG

A pottery vessel containing silver Roman coins. The coins were all tightly packed within the vessel, a small flagon, and were not removed at the time of discovery. They were later taken to the British Museum for removal from the vessel and cleaning in the conservation laboratory before identification and cataloguing. Description of Find: In total, 662 coins were discovered, all late Roman silver…
